title: Cross Products: Four Cases
body: Find the cross product $$\vec{A}\times\vec{C}$$ for each of the following: (a) $$\vec{A}=2.0\hat{i}-4.0\hat{j}+\hat{k},$$ $$\vec{C}=3.0\hat{i}+4.0\hat{j}+10.0\hat{k};$$ (b) $$\vec{A}=3.0\hat{i}+4.0\hat{j}+10.0\hat{k},$$ $$\vec{C}=2.0\hat{i}-4.0\hat{j}+\hat{k};$$ (c) $$\vec{A}=-3.0\hat{i}-4.0\hat{j}, $$ $$\vec{C}=-3.0\hat{i}+4.0\hat{j};$$ (d) $$\vec{A}=-9.0\hat{j}, $$ $$\vec{C}=-2.0\hat{i}+3.0\hat{j}+2.0\hat{k}$$.
